meta_description: Barry Dixon Decorators in Leeds. Expert interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating. Family business, free quotes, reliable local service.
hero_subhead: Expert interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorating across Leeds and Morley. Free quotes, no mess left behind.
services_subhead: From a single room refresh to whole-house renovation, we handle every decorating job with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Full room makeovers including painting, wallpapering, and feature walls. We protect your furniture and leave you with immaculate finishes.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paint for doors, windows, fascias, and cladding. We use premium paints and prepare surfaces properly for lasting results.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging, feature walls, and textured finishes. We remove old paper cleanly and hang new coverings with precision.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Painting
services.desc: Professional painting of skirting boards, architraves, doors, and window frames. Hard-wearing finishes that stand up to daily wear.

services.title: Facia & Soffit Work
services.desc: Reliable painting and maintenance of fascias, soffits, and guttering. We prep surfaces thoroughly and use durable external paints.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Work
services.desc: Proper surface preparation is key to lasting paint work. We fill, sand, and prime all surfaces to guarantee a smooth, professional finish.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own—no rushing, no shortcuts, just honest work.
about_para_1: Barry Dixon Decorators started more than 20 years ago with a simple belief: that honest craftsmanship and attention to detail matter. Based in Morley, we've built a solid reputation across Leeds and the surrounding areas by delivering reliable, high-quality decorating work on time and within budget. Whether it's a small room refresh or a full interior renovation, we approach every job professionally.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we do what we say we'll do. We turn up on time, we tidy up after ourselves, and we don't disappear halfway through a job. We use quality materials, prepare surfaces properly, and stand behind our work. That's why so many Leeds homeowners trust us to transform their homes.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Barry and his team painted our kitchen and hallway. Really tidy workers, took their time to prep everything properly, and the finish is fantastic. Couldn't be happier with the result. Will be calling them back to do the living room.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had the whole house decorated—interior doors, skirting, walls, the lot. They were professional, reliable, and the work is brilliant. Fair price too. Highly recommend if you want a job done properly.
reviews.author: Michelle H.

reviews.text: Barry sorted out our exterior woodwork and fascias. Proper old-school craftsman. He explained what needed doing, quoted honestly, and the paint work has held up beautifully through the winter. Exactly what a tradesman should be.
reviews.author: Paul K.
